name: The Siphon Quenched: Mechanicus Triumph & Commander's Respite

cycle_advancement.world_state: Promethium Siphon Sealed — Commander Resting in Basilica Sanctus

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The Basilica of Saint Katherine's Tears is shrouded in peaceful incense smoke. Sergeant Kathryn Vane rests in the honored officer's quarters, while the Sol-Aegis Plasma Core hums softly in the central transept under the vigilant gaze of Bone 'ead Bragg.

The scorched fuel conduits hiss with cooling Mechanicus unguents. The fused metal shells of two sacrifice-servitors seal the main valve flange, while Enginseer Kroll chants binharic benedictions over the stabilized pressure gauges.

completed_milestones.title: Catastrophic Promethium Siphon Rupture Quenched
completed_milestones.consequence: Operating with full autonomous authority while Sergeant Vane recuperated, Enginseer Fabricator Kroll deployed the heat-shielded Kastelan Automaton and sacrificed 2 defense servitors to permanently weld the leaking 2,000°C promethium main, averting sector annihilation.

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: SECTOR SECURED: Promethium siphon leak quenched by Enginseer Kroll. Sergeant Vane rests in the Basilica Sanctus.

new_decision.decision: Granted operational autonomy to Bragg and Kroll, retiring to the officer's quarters in the Basilica of Saint Katherine's Tears to bandage wounds, clean the Mark VII Chainsword, and rest under the protection of Bragg and the Sol-Aegis Core.
new_decision.impact: Full biological recuperation; physical vitality restored to 105/115 and dissonance cleansed to 0 as command autonomy resolved the sector crisis without casualty.

new_decision.decision: Communed with the newly bound Kastelan Automaton, directing it to form a thermal shield wedge against the 2,000-degree promethium jet; sacrificed 2 defense servitors to clamp the flange, and manually quenched the isolation valve with sacred unguents.
new_decision.impact: Single-handedly saved Sub-Level 404 from catastrophic explosion; restored full fuel stability and elevated sector containment to 98%.

new_decision.decision: Marched the 800-pound Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor safely into the Basilica transept, placed it at the foot of the golden Aquila, and stood vigilant guard outside the Sarge's quarters with humming Power Fist raised.
new_decision.impact: Guaranteed total physical security for the Sergeant while she slept, proud of his service to the Emperor.

new_decision.decision: Took up overwatch position at the Basilica entrance with his newly acquired Mark IV Plasma Gun, coordinating with the vanguard to ensure no stragglers breached the holy perimeter.
new_decision.impact: Maintained an iron perimeter around the resting command staff.
